payload.content: A weighted base and upright roll design make this 6.5-inch freestanding paper towel holder a stable, space-saving choice for the kitchen counter, crafted from solid brass. {FINISH_SENTENCE} The classic traditional look—blending contemporary lines with traditional design elements—adds a refined hardware-style detail while keeping paper towels within easy reach for one-handed tearing. A felt pad under the base helps prevent scratching on your countertop, and the designer finish is designed for corrosion-free, rust-free performance. This countertop stand is a simple alternative to an under cabinet paper towel holder when you want no drilling and easy repositioning. From the Carolina Collection by Allied Brass; includes the paper towel holder and is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
